gitCommit.subject: Turn off thinking for agent text calls, and give personas their length limits
gitCommit.body:
Turn off thinking for agent text calls, and give personas their length limits

On production, Claude 5.5 models thought before answering. The thinking counted
towards each agent's maxOutputTokens, so replies were cut off mid-JSON ("The reply
was not valid JSON"), most often for Suggest lines (600 tokens) and the personas.
Text calls now send thinking disabled: Haiku honours it, and Sonnet gets its lowest
setting. The persona instructions now state the 200 and 250 character limits the
output schema enforces.
